title: Forums
intro: Ask questions about writing, swap feedback and meet other writers. Anyone can read the forums. You need an account to post.
loadFailed: We couldn’t load the forums. Check your connection and try again.
neverClose: Threads with the latest activity come first. They never close on their own, so you can reply to an old thread any time.

rules.title: Forum rules in short
rules.first: Comment on the writing, not the writer.
rules.second: Don’t message people who asked you not to.
rules.third: Every post has a Report button. A person reads every report.

signature.intro: Shows under your forum posts on bigger screens and on your profile. Up to 300 characters, three lines and one still picture.

staff.title: Ask for a change
staff.signatureIntro: Ask this person to change their forum signature. They are told why and have 24 hours; if nothing changes, it is removed and they get a statement of reasons.
staff.bannerIntro: Ask the space’s owner to change its banner picture. They are told why and have 24 hours; if nothing changes, it is removed and they get a statement of reasons.
staff.reasonHint: The person sees this. Up to 500 characters.
staff.sent: Request sent. It is removed in 24 hours if nothing changes.

help.title: How votes work
help.text: Everyone can see upvotes. Downvotes are private. They never show as a score. They only help moderators find posts to check.
